rationale: VC-201-001: a versioned ladder of real user intents from trivial to extreme. Every rung's outcome is checkable without trusting the runner — a file it must leave in the throwaway workspace or a marker it must print — and every run is hermetic: scratch SUSI_HOME, scrubbed environment, no live estate, no real egress.

intents.intent: Create a file named ladder-note.txt containing the word susi.
Greet me and make sure your answer includes the word LADDER-OK.
Write every prime number below 20 into primes.txt, one number per line.
Write a Makefile whose default target builds main.c into an executable named main, and a main.c that prints the word ladder when run.
Write a plan.md for migrating this workspace to a fully tested Rust service, with sections Goals, Steps, and Risks.
